sections.heading: Deoria Me Full Body Checkup Me Kya Aata Hai — Pehle Seedha Jawab
sections.lead: Ek line me: khoon ki ginti, sugar, cholesterol, liver, kidney aur peshab ki jaanch. Baaki sab isi ke upar judta hai.
blocks: Deoria me jo full body checkup package aam taur par milte hain, unki neev ek jaisi hoti hai: CBC (haemoglobin, WBC aur platelet), fasting blood sugar, lipid profile (cholesterol aur triglyceride), LFT yaani liver ki jaanch, KFT yaani kidney ki jaanch, aur urine routine. Advanced package me iske upar HbA1c, thyroid (TSH), Vitamin D aur Vitamin B12 jud jaate hain, aur 45 ke upar walon ke liye urine microalbumin bhi. Sab kuch ek hi baar khoon aur peshab ke sample se ho jaata hai — alag-alag din ya alag sui nahi.

"Full body checkup" koi ek jaanch nahi hai. Ye kai test ka ek bandal hai jo ek hi sample se, ek hi baar me ho jaata hai — sugar, kidney, liver, thyroid, cholesterol aur khoon ki ginti jaise hisse milkar ise banate hain. Isi liye do labs ke "full body checkup" ek doosre se bilkul alag ho sakte hain, aur dono apne aap ko poora bataate hain.

Deoria me ye checkup zyadatar teen mauko par karaya jaata hai. Pehla — saal ka routine, jab ghar me kisi ko koi shikayat nahi hoti lekin umar 35 paar kar chuki hoti hai. Doosra — jab koi bahar se, Surat, Delhi, Mumbai ya Gulf se, kuch dinon ke liye ghar aata hai aur usi beech sab kuch nipta lena hota hai. Teesra — Gorakhpur me doctor dikhane se pehle, taaki report haath me rahe aur ek chakkar bach jaaye.

Aur is poore page par kisi test ka rate jaan-boojh kar nahi likha gaya: rate ek hi jagah rehta hai, taaki wo do pages par alag-alag na ho jaaye.

sections.lead: Ginti chhod dijiye. Chhah hisse dhoondhiye.

list: Sugar — sirf fasting sugar hai, ya HbA1c bhi? HbA1c teen mahine ka ausat batata hai aur wahi package ko asli banata hai.
Kidney — KFT, ya kam se kam creatinine aur urea. Ghar me sugar ya BP ka itihaas ho to ye chhoot nahi sakta.
Liver — LFT, jismein SGPT, SGOT aur bilirubin aate hain.

Lipid — poora lipid profile, sirf "cholesterol" naam ka ek akela number nahi.
Khoon ki ginti — CBC; aur mahilaon ke liye ho to saath me ferritin ya vitamin B12 bhi.

faqs.question: Deoria me full body checkup kitne ka hota hai — daam kis baat par tay hota hai?
faqs.answer: Daam is baat par tay hota hai ki package me kaunse test hain, kitne parameters likhe hain us par nahi. HbA1c, thyroid profile, vitamin D aur vitamin B12 jaise test package ka bada hissa banate hain, jabki haemoglobin ya urine routine jaise test sasta padte hain — isi liye 60 parameters wala package 30 test wale package se kamzor bhi ho sakta hai. Home sample collection Deoria me free hai, isliye uska koi alag charge nahi judta. Har package aur test ka rate Deoria ke service page par ek hi jagah likha hai, aur total confirmation call par pehle hi bata diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Package lena chahiye ya doctor ke likhe hue alag-alag test?
faqs.answer: Parcha haath me hai to wahi karwaiye. Doctor ne teen test likhe hain aur aap 40 test wala package le lete hain to wo sasta nahi pada — us me se 37 test ka aapke abhi ke sawaal se koi lena-dena nahi hai. Package tab sahi baithta hai jab koi khaas shikayat na ho aur aap saal ka routine karana chahte hon, kyunki tab alag-alag test book karne se package aam taur par kam padta hai. Tay na kar paayein to booking form bhar dijiye aur parche ki photo bhej dijiye — call par bata diya jaayega ki aapke liye kya theek rahega.

faqs.question: Rudrapur, Barhaj ya Bhatpar Rani me rehte hain — full body checkup ghar par ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Haan. Sample Deoria Sadar ke saath Rudrapur, Barhaj, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni tak ghar par liya jaata hai, aur in kasbon se lage gaon bhi aam taur par cover hote hain. Daam kasbe ke hisaab se nahi badalta aur ghar se sample lene ka alag charge nahi lagta. Booking ke waqt tola ya mohalle ke naam ke saath ek jaana-pehchana landmark likhwaiye, kyunki subah ke fasting slot me pata saaf hona hi visit ko samay par rakhta hai.

faqs.question: Ek package me 80 parameters likhe hain aur doosre me 40 — kya pehla behtar hai?
faqs.answer: Zaroori nahi. Ek akela CBC hi bees se zyada parameters gin leta hai, isliye ginti badhana aasan hai aur wo apne aap kuch nahi batati. Dono soochi saamne rakhiye aur chhah hisse dekhiye: sugar me HbA1c hai ya nahi, kidney ke liye KFT (ya kam se kam creatinine aur urea), liver ke liye LFT, thyroid me sirf TSH hai ya poora profile, poora lipid profile, aur CBC. Jis package me ye chhah mil jaayein wo behtar hai, chaahe uski ginti kam ho. Jismein vitamin D aur B12 bhi hon wo aur poora hai, lekin uska daam bhi usi hisaab se rahega.

faqs.question: Bukhar abhi-abhi utra hai — kya main full body checkup karwa sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Routine package ke liye kam se kam do hafte ruk jaaiye. Bukhar ke dauraan aur uske turant baad CBC ke kai number apne aap upar-neeche rehte hain, aur us report ko baad me apna sadharan number maan lena galat rahega — agle saal ki tulna bhi usi se bigadti hai. Ye baat sirf routine checkup par lagu hai: doctor ne bimari ke silsile me koi test likha hai to wo turant karwaiye, use rokna nahi hai. Deoria me barsaat ke baad ka mahina bimari ke test ka hota hai; routine package ke liye jaada ka mausam sabse aasan rehta hai.

faqs.question: Ghar ke chaar log package karana chahte hain — rate alag hoga aur visit alag?
faqs.answer: Visit ek hi lagegi, rate har vyakti ka apna. Ek hi subah me chaaron ka sample liya ja sakta hai aur home collection phir bhi free rehta hai; booking ke waqt sirf bata dijiye ki kitne log hain aur kis-kis ka kaun sa package hai. Sabko khaali pet rakhiye, kyunki package me sugar aur lipid dono hote hain — haan, jis bachche ka sirf CBC ya vitamin ho raha hai use fasting ki zaroorat nahi. Har vyakti ki report alag PDF me, 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp aur email par aa jaati hai.

faqs.question: Kya aapke full body checkup me X-ray, ECG ya ultrasound bhi shaamil hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Hamare package me sirf wo jaanch hai jo khoon ya peshab ke sample par hoti hai. X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, TMT aur CT scan machine par hote hain, unke liye centre par jaana hi padta hai, aur hum Deoria me kisi imaging centre se jude hone ka daawa nahi karte. Doctor ne dono likhe hain to khoon wali jaanch ghar se karwa lijiye aur imaging ke liye centre jaaiye — dono report doctor ko ek saath dikhaiye. Kisi bhi package me imaging likha dikhe to poochh lijiye ki wo kis centre par hoga aur uska rate alag hai ya nahi.

faqs.question: Pichhle saal ki report kho gayi hai — kya package ka poora fayda ab bhi milega?
faqs.answer: Fayda hai — is saal ka number apne aap me kaam ka hai aur wahi agle saal ka aadhaar ban jaayega. Lekin poora fayda tulna me hai: saal bhar me creatinine, HbA1c ya haemoglobin kis taraf khiska, ye ek akeli report nahi bata sakti. Isliye is baar ki PDF sambhaal kar rakhiye — wo WhatsApp aur email dono par aati hai, isliye phone badalne par bhi email me padi rehti hai. Aur aage ke liye ek baat: jo number aap saal-dar-saal dekhenge unhe hamesha ek hi lab se karaiye, kyunki har lab ka analyser aur reference range apna hota hai.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kaun se test hote hain?
faqs.answer: Basic package me aam taur par CBC, fasting sugar, lipid profile, LFT (liver) aur KFT (kidney) aate hain. Advanced package me inke upar HbA1c, poora thyroid profile, urine routine, urine microalbumin, Vitamin D aur B12 jud jaate hain. Do package me farak asal me yahi teen-chaar cheezon ka hota hai. Chunte waqt ginti mat dekhiye — ye dekhiye ki paanch system poore hain ya nahi: khoon, sugar, dil, liver aur kidney.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, zyadatar package ke liye 10 se 12 ghante khaali pet rehna padta hai. Wajah lipid profile aur fasting sugar hai — dono khaane par seedha hil jaate hain, khaas kar triglycerides. Us dauraan saada paani peena mana nahi hai, balki peete rahna behtar hai; sirf chai, doodh, juice aur khaana mana hai. Isi liye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot sabse aasan padta hai — raat ka khaana 9 baje tak kar lijiye aur naashta sample ke turant baad.

faqs.question: Deoria me full body checkup ki report kitne din me aa jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar package ki report 24 ghante ke andar PDF me phone par aa jaati hai — CBC, sugar, HbA1c, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid aur urine routine sab isme. Vitamin D aur B12 bhi aam taur par usi samay me. Sirf urine culture alag hai, usme 48 se 72 ghante lagte hain. Gorakhpur me OPD dikhani ho to sample ek din pehle de dijiye — report phone par rehti hai, print le kar chalna zaroori nahi.

faqs.question: Full body checkup me kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Ghar par sample lene ki visit me 10 se 15 minute lagte hain. Poora package ek hi baar nas se liye gaye khoon par ho jaata hai, isliye har test ke liye alag sui nahi lagti; urine ka container saath me chhod diya jaata hai. Booking ke baad confirmation call lagbhag 30 minute me aa jaati hai. Poora din kahin nahi jaata — sirf fasting ke 10 se 12 ghante planning maangte hain, aur wo raat me poore ho jaate hain.
